# nocheck

> Checks turned off: the check truck's statements, with require, ensure and invariant costing nothing.

[source](../../registry/nocheck.pkg) · truck

`use nocheck` in place of `use check` gives the same statements, but
`require`, `ensure` and `invariant` never evaluate their condition or
messages (they are still type-checked). `unreachable` and `todo` are the
same as in `check`.

```
use std
use nocheck

require expensive_check(data), "data is broken"   // costs nothing
```
